summary: C-0001: 2023-2025 neuroimaging shows hypnosis produces reliable, replicable changes in large-scale brain network connectivity (DMN/SN/ECN), consistent with a genuine altered brain state rather than pure faking.
content: C-0001 (claim): Recent (2023-2025) neuroimaging converges on the finding that hypnosis induction produces measurable changes in large-scale brain network connectivity — particularly reduced activity in dACC, reduced DLPFC-PCC/DMN coupling, altered DLPFC-insula coupling, and depth-dependent parieto-occipital-temporal connectivity. Multiple independent groups (de Matos 2023, Moujaes 2024, Vazquez 2023) report consistent direction-of-effect. This is more consistent with a genuine altered brain state than with pure compliance/role-playing. supports: EV-0001, EV-0002, EV-0003, EV-0005, EV-0006, EV-0007. contradicts: (none directly; but see C-0002).
